questions.history: Close the owner after the late registry joins the global composite.
questions.prediction: The parent’s earlier bean snapshot predicts a stale global member. On the merge the instance should be absent and closed.
questions.basis: The late definition did not exist when the closer was constructed. The landed tests track removal and closing separately.
questions.refutation: On the merge, membership remains or `isClosed()` is false after owner close.

questions.history: Set `management.metrics.use-global-registry=false` in a fresh context and repeat late registration.
questions.prediction: On both revisions the local bean should work before shutdown and should never join the global composite.
questions.basis: An opt-out separates local instrumentation from process-wide publication.
questions.refutation: The fixture cannot use the local counter before closure, or the registry appears globally.

questions.history: Create independent contexts A and B with distinct late registries and global registration enabled. Close A, increment a counter through B, then close B.
questions.prediction: On the merge A disappears and closes, while B remains globally registered and its counter advances by one. After B closes it too disappears.
questions.basis: Each registration has an owner. The live registry and an actual increment detect an overbroad cleanup.
questions.refutation: Closing A removes or closes B, the increment is lost, or B remains after its own closure.
